title: Grassier Grass
description: Grassier Grass turns Minecraft's flat, static grass into a lush field that actually moves!
body:
# About
**Grassier Grass** turns Minecraft's flat, static grass into a lush field that actually moves, every blade is rendered through a custom wind shader with rolling gusts, so grass leans and ripples in the breeze. Fully configurable via Sodium's menu.
